closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin C, brings a clean fruit identity, and easy to use as a whole food, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low protein amount, and low vitamin A. It's good for practical meals, immune support, and low-calorie volume because it's easy to build meals around, vitamin C and vitamin A help support the immune system, and it helps fill out a meal without many calories.
